summary: Bloomberg : Source: President Trump is scheduled to lead a December 4 groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC's Phoenix plant expansion, deepening his chip sector involvement — President Donald Trump will headline the groundbreaking on a major new semiconductor manufacturing project in Arizona next week …
